name: encode so adjacent values differ in one bit
mechanism: map integers to binary words so that consecutive integers differ in exactly one bit (each word is the integer exclusive-or its right shift), so a transition between neighbours can never be misread as a far value

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gray code' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction:

fails_when: arithmetic is awkward in the coded form
